records.title: Senior Product Analytics Manager - Wise Business

jd.text:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
Your Mission:
We're looking for a Senior Product Analytics Manager to lead analytics for the Business Account Squad at Wise.
You’ll lead a team of 5+ analysts who are embedded in the product teams that are building the primary account businesses use for their banking needs - globally!
The Business Account Squad sits at the heart of our proposition for businesses, building solutions to ensure that businesses can successfully and safely start to use Wise; empowering them with the workflows and controls needed to run their finances globally with ease!
Robust analytical leadership is critical to ensure we proactively leverage data to shape our roadmap and drive high-impact initiatives, ensuring that every product decision makes moving money faster, cheaper, and easier for everyone, everywhere.
This is an AL2 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here .
What you’ll be doing:
Partner with Product/Engineering/Design leads to identify opportunities to improve our product and bring them to life; review team plans and progress, giving them effective feedback.
Create and communicate a clear picture of progress against product goals. Ensure that we have clear goals, measurable KPIs, narrate our progress and drive action to accelerate progress.
Own the data strategy for Business Account Analytics: define the roadmap to build the data and tools necessary to scale impact. Increase the speed and effectiveness of decision making across the squad.
Lead, develop and support a team of high performing analysts. Support analyst professional development via performance feedback & coaching; hire and plan capacity and ensure that analyst efforts maximise impact.
What you’ll bring:
5-6 years experience as an analyst and 2-5 years leading others (can be overlapping)
You have experience working with product teams: identifying and evaluating opportunities that will maximise impact for customers and KPI progress; evaluating the impact of what you shipped; recommending changes and new initiatives.
Analytical thinker with strong analysis skills (SQL, Python), data modelling (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and experience using event data (e.g. Mixpanel).
Bias to action: you identify what needs to be done and make it happen.
You can work independently in a fast-paced environment (able to identify impactful projects and evaluate & triage inbound requests).
Strong stakeholder management skills - you are collaborative, you know how to influence and when to say yes or no to maximise impact.
B2B experience and familiarity with business financial workflows are preferred, but not required.
What do we offer:
Salary: £105,000 - £150,000
Company Restricted Stock Units
Numerous great benefits in our London office
Key benefits:
Hybrid working
Paid annual holiday, sick days, parental leave and other leave opportunities
6 weeks of paid sabbatical after 4 years at Wise on top of annual leave
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs .
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram .

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
Wise Business has historically grown through self-serve and product-led channels. We’re now building a dedicated velocity sales team to help larger businesses discover, adopt, and fully activate on Wise for their international payment and banking needs. We’re looking for an experienced Salesforce & GTM Systems Specialist, who is passionate about the Wise mission – money without borders – to join our GTM Systems team. This is a key role in driving performance by collaborating with commercial leadership, revenue operations, analytics, marketing and other cross-function teams to ensure the execution of our Go-To-Market strategies. This will be a high impact and visibility role. The role is based in our London office, but you will also work closely with the global Wise Business Sales teams.
Since 2011, we’ve had a clear mission: money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives, we’re the fairest, easiest way to manage your money across borders.
Over 10 million active personal and 700,000 business customers now use Wise to move more than £25 billion across borders each quarter, and saved £1.5 billion compared to banks over the past year.
A bit about the role:
In this role you will be responsible for designing and building the systems that power the Wise Business go-to-market engine. You will utilise your Salesforce expertise alongside other key tools across marketing, enrichment and engagement to build and optimize processes for our commercial teams for this high velocity business. You will work cross functionally to partner with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement & Marketing to translate their needs into scalable systems and workflows that accelerate and streamline a fast growing area of the business. You will lead tooling for the newly setup Wise Business Sales teams and should be excited about the 0-1 build phase. You must be self-driven, motivated and comfortable with ambiguity. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Salesforce and systems that goes beyond administration within a high growth environment, preferably in the fintech space.
Your mission:
Own the Wise Business area within the GTM Systems team - Contribute to scaling, supporting growth and driving success of the function through enablement of tooling and processes that you will build.
Design, build and maintain Salesforce solutions, from complex flows to custom objects and third-party integrations.
Design, build and iterate from the ground up towards a world class sales process - that streamlines Lead Intake, Scoring, Routing and Qualification utilising Salesforce and GTM Systems.
Work cross functionally with key stakeholders across Sales, RevOps, Sales Enablement, Marketing and Analytics to identify key pain points and initiatives. Refining these into a prioritisation to focus on delivering what will bring the most impact.
Lead complex cross-functional initiatives end to end, from technical scoping through build, deployment and rollout.
Proactively identify areas of opportunity to improve our processes, whether using Salesforce solutions and features, leveraging our existing GTM Systems or looking for new vendors we should partner with.
Contribute internally to team planning, strategy and team processes to accelerate our own capabilities.
A bit about you:
You have strong experience with GTM Systems: 5+ years working across GTM Systems in a high growth and high velocity deal environment.
You have a lot of hands-on Salesforce experience:
8+ years of Salesforce experience - Expertise beyond administration.
You've led complex cross-functional builds end to end, from scoping through build.
You have demonstrable experience in data modelling, building complex flows in flow builder, Salesforce integration with internal/third party systems.
Certifications are preferable, but we’re looking for hands-on experience within a business.
You enjoy problem solving - By nature you are a problem solver - you don’t need to know the answer to every question, but can be presented with a business issue and take this away to formulate a scalable solutions to solve it.
You are technically minded - Working with technology, systems, tools is something that gives you energy. You stay up to date naturally on latest developments in tech across Salesforce, AI and related technologies.
You are a strong communicator - You have strong communication skills, stakeholder management and enjoy working with non technical stakeholders to translate their needs into solutions.
High Growth environment - You have previously worked in a high growth environment (startup and/or scaleup) in a build phase and are comfortable with ambiguity.
You have experience working across multi systems - You have experience working across the whole GTM stack to build seamless, integrated data surfacing processes:
Salesforce - Sales Cloud
Marketing - HubSpot, Marketing Cloud (Pardot), Braze
Revenue Intelligence & Productivity - Weflow, Gong
Lead Enrichment - Cognism, ZoomInfo, Clay, Apollo
Lead Signal - 6sense, Demandbase, Clay
Sales Engagement - Salesloft, Apollo
Integration & Automation - Workato, Zapier, Mulesoft
Deployment - DevOps, Gearset, Copado
Admin tools - Data loader, Workbench, Spreadsheets, SF Inspector
AI - Slackbot, Agentforce, Gemini, Credal.ai, ChatGPT/Codex
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs .

Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality.
Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. As we continue to expand our investment base, we are dedicated to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £8 billion in renewable energy assets.
We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero.
About the role:
We are seeking a Portfolio Associate to join the OEGEN Funds Team, reporting to the Senior Portfolio Manager.
The role will work across OEGEN’s listed funds, semi-liquid strategies and private funds, supporting investments in renewable infrastructure and liquid investments.
You will support the Senior Portfolio Manager across the full fund-management cycle, including portfolio analysis, valuations, cash-flow forecasting, debt, FX, hedging, governance and investor reporting. You will also have a particular role in analysing allocations and underlying fund information across semi-liquid and liquid strategies, reviewing valuations and asset performance across private market investments, and supporting the Finance team with monthly NAV processes.
The role would suit someone with a strong finance, accounting or investment background who is analytical, organised and comfortable working across recurring processes and more judgement-led portfolio analysis. It offers the opportunity to develop broad fund-management experience across a varied set of OEGEN portfolios.
What You'll Do
Portfolio management: Support the Senior Portfolio Manager with the day-to-day management of assigned portfolios, including monitoring investments, asset performance, fund KPIs, distributions, commitments, liquidity and investor returns. You will work with Asset Management, Investment, Finance and other teams to understand issues and ensure that actions are followed through.
Valuations and financial modelling: Support monthly, quarterly and annual valuation processes, including updating and reviewing DCF, investment and fund models, analysing assumptions, preparing valuation bridges and sensitivities, and challenging outputs from internal teams, external valuers and underlying managers. You will prepare clear analysis for internal and external stakeholders.
Cash flow, debt and hedging: Support cash-flow forecasting and analysis across the portfolios, including distributions, capital calls, liquidity, recycling and commitments. You will also help monitor debt structures, refinancing activity, managing covenants, hedging and other financial arrangements relevant to the funds, working closely with Finance and Investment teams.
Allocation and underlying fund analysis: Support analysis of portfolio construction, asset allocation and investment exposures, including gathering and assessing information from underlying funds and managers. This will include helping to draw together performance and portfolio information from semi-liquid and liquid investments and turning it into useful fund-level analysis and reporting.
Investor reporting: Lead or coordinate inputs into high-quality investor reports, factsheets, customer board materials, investor meetings and due diligence responses. You will help explain asset and portfolio performance, allocation, valuation movements, distributions, risks and outlook clearly and accurately for investors across the different fund types.
Private fund NAV and reporting: Work with the Finance team to support monthly NAV processes for underlying private funds, including checking underlying information, reconciling movements and maintaining clear supporting evidence. You will also help oversee and report on asset performance, review valuation outputs and identify questions or inconsistencies for escalation.
Risk and governance: Support the Senior Portfolio Manager in ensuring that funds are governed correctly and that information provided to Boards, customer boards, auditors and other governance forums is accurate. You will monitor risks including underperformance, valuation movements, liquidity, debt covenants, mandate constraints and material data gaps, escalating issues promptly.
Process improvement: Maintain accurate fund-level information for NAV, AUM, returns, distributions, commitments and track record, and look for practical improvements to reporting, controls, data collection and automation. You will help ensure that processes are documented, deadlines are managed and outputs are consistent and auditable
What You'll Need
At least three years of relevant experience in fund management, fund accounting, financial reporting, audit, transaction services, infrastructure, renewable energy, valuations, investment analysis or a comparable analytical role.
A strong finance or accounting background. A CFA or accounting qualification would be advantageous.
Good understanding of fund-management processes, including NAV, valuations, AUM, investor reporting, cash-flow forecasting, distributions, audit and governance.
Strong Excel and financial-modelling skills, including the ability to review models, analyse assumptions, reconcile outputs and perform scenario and sensitivity analysis. A modelling test may form part of the recruitment process.
Experience of analysing investment, fund or asset performance and creating high-quality investor or management information.
Experience with renewable energy, infrastructure, real assets, private markets, listed investment vehicles or multi-asset portfolios would be advantageous.

We’re looking for a second Data Protection Manager to join our team and support our fast growing business.
Working closely with our DPO and existing Data Protection Manager you’ll ensure we remain compliant with UK GDPR legislation and processes while also working with various teams to expand our capabilities and develop creative solutions to business challenges and opportunities to improve our service to both new and existing customers.
Whilst this is a Data Protection role, we’re looking for someone technically experienced who can come in and shape the technical landscape of Data Protection as well as how we internally develop the tools to deliver these services to our business.
What you'll do...
Develop our data protection strategy, policies, frameworks and tools to ensure our compliance with UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, PECR and other relevant legislation.
Advise on data privacy matters for teams across the company from software engineers, financial specialists to marketing and business development.
Maintain records and documentation by leading Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), updating the Record of Processing Activities (RoPA), and conducting Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIAs).
Own and refine the end-to-end processes for Subject Rights Management including Data Subject Access Requests (SARs) and other data subject rights.
Manage breaches including investigation, reporting, and communication with the ICO.
Contribute to growth by supporting our business development teams with customer data protection agreements and enquiries.
Manage risk by conducting due diligence for third-party suppliers and vendors.
Raise awareness through design and delivering engaging data protection training and awareness campaigns .
Monitor the evolving privacy regulatory landscape and report on the company's compliance and risk.
What you'll need...
A passion for Data Protection and a proven track record of delivering compliance with legislation in a fast paced business.
Experience working with software product teams building bespoke software for delivering customer and internal solutions.
Familiarily with modern tooling including Google Workspace and Slack.
The ability to explain Data Protection concepts in a clear and relatable way to those who may not be familiar with them.
Forward-thinking, self-motivated and able to take responsibility for your own initiatives and drive them to implementation.
Experience of working in a pressured environment, prioritising your work appropriately while maintaining high levels of attention to detail.
Any of the following would be a bonus
Awareness of Information Security principles and requirements for ISO27001 compliance
Knowledge of the FCA regulation and experience in the financial services industry
A background in technology
Why you'll love it here
Don't feel like you meet all of our hiring criteria? Thats OK, apply anyway! We'd love to hear from you and have a conversation.
Octopus Electric Vehicles , part of the Octopus Energy Group, won the Sunday Times best company to work for in 2024. We were named 6th out of the top 100 start-ups to work for by Tempo in 2025 and on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022 . Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people
Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!
Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture . An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! Visit our perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits
Things to Note...
🐶 just to let you know, we are dog friendly company so you may see our 4 legged friends in the offices - feel free to bring yours! Rest assured though, we've taken lots of precautions for those who have allergies
🤖 We use AI to help us assess applications fairly and objectively. We’re totally fine with you using AI as a tool to help prepare too. That said, when we get to the interview and assessment stage, we’re really interested in hearing your unique perspective and real-world stories. That’s the stuff we can’t get from a bot or a prompt!

Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need loads more people to help us make our vision a reality.
You'll be responsible for:
Working as part of a team of two to install low carbon technology in customers’ homes, starting with Air Source Heat Pumps.
Using your knowledge and experience of domestic heating and plumbing systems to prepare and install unvented cylinders, pipework, and radiators
Planning and communicating with the wider team and customers
Continuously learning about new technologies at our innovative R&D training centre

Data:

Webuild è un player globale delle costruzioni specializzato nella realizzazione di grandi opere e infrastrutture complesse per la mobilità sostenibile, l’energia idroelettrica, l’acqua, i green buildings, il tunneling.
Espressione di 120 anni di esperienza ingegneristica applicata in 50 paesi dei cinque continenti, grazie al talento di 91.000 persone di oltre 120 nazionalità, e con un portafoglio ordini totale di €65 miliardi (Risultati economico finanziari consolidati al 30 giugno 2024), Webuild è un gruppo guidato dalla passione per il costruire e dalla ricerca dell’eccellenza, che ha rinnovato il suo impegno a costruire un futuro sostenibile applicando il suo know-how per la realizzazione di opere innovative e di valore.
Cost Analyst – Tendering & Construction Methods
Siamo alla ricerca di un Cost & Methods Analyst da inserire team “Estimating & Methods” presso la sede di Milano.
La figura supporterà il Dipartimento Bidding nell’analisi tecnico-economica delle offerte e contribuirà, all’interno di team multidisciplinari, allo sviluppo dei metodi esecutivi per opere infrastrutturali complesse, con particolare riferimento a opere in calcestruzzo e scavo di gallerie, nell’ambito di gare nazionali e internazionali.
Responsabilità principali:
Analisi dei documenti di gara (computi metrici, disegni, capitolati, relazioni tecniche) per individuare criticità e opportunità.
Stima dei costi diretti in collaborazione con i team tecnici, assicurando coerenza con le ipotesi esecutive.
Valutazione e proposta di soluzioni alternative per ottimizzare costi e tempi.
Responsabilità dell’analisi economica di offerta, con particolare riferimento ai costi diretti, e contributo allo sviluppo dei metodi operativi nell’ambito di un team multidisciplinare, assicurando coerenza tra ipotesi esecutive, produttività e struttura dei costi.
Collaborazione con il team Procurement per il confronto Make or Buy.
Redazione della documentazione economica richiesta dai bandi (BoQ, price breakdown, lista macchinari).
Supporto all’analisi dei rischi economico-finanziari e alla definizione di eventuali varianti tecniche.
Requisiti:
Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Civile ,
5 anni+ di esperienza;
Conoscenza di MS Office (in particolare Excel);
Conoscenza fluente dell'inglese (scritto e parlato); ulteriori lingue sono un plus;
Disponibilità a viaggiare all'estero.
lettura di elaborati tecnici e computi metrici;
basi di pianificazione lavori e produttività;
esperienza in infrastrutture, gallerie, opere civili complesse;
eventuale conoscenza di software di estimating come Candy/CCS, Primus, STR, Excel avanzato.
Completano il profilo:
Spiccate capacità analitiche e di risoluzione dei problemi;
Ottime capacità di lavoro in team e di collaborazione tra le diverse funzioni aziendali;
Orientamento ai risultati.
Condizioni contrattuali ed economiche
Inquadramento e CCNL: CCNL Edilizia Industria, livello 7
Tipo di contratto: Tempo Indeterminato
Fascia retributiva (RAL): 46.000 € – 55.000 €
Elementi complementari: buoni pasto, servizio di telemedicina, polizza sanitaria, assicurazione infortuni e previdenza complementare
Modalità di lavoro: Ibrida (max 8 giorni al mese da remoto)
La definizione della proposta complessiva sarà basata su una valutazione del profilo, che tenga conto del percorso professionale maturato e dell’insieme di capacità tecniche e trasversali, in coerenza con il contesto organizzativo e funzionali al raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali.
La ricerca è rivolta ai candidati dell’uno e dell’altro sesso (L.903/77 e D.Lgs.198/06). Construction, Estimator, Procurement, Engineering, Finance, Operations

Senior Trade Marketing Manager
THE POSITION
The Senior Trade Marketing Manager is responsible for defining and executing the trade marketing strategy across key customer channels (pharmacies, vet clinics, pet stores, chains, mass market, and others), ensuring superior customer activation, category growth, and commercial excellence. The role acts as the critical link between Marketing, Sales, Commercial Excellence, Supply, and external partners, translating brand strategies into impactful customer-facing activation plans that drive demand, visibility, conversion, and sustainable growth within every channel.
This is a senior leadership role for a strategic and commercially minded professional who can shape the future of Trade Marketing within the Pet Business Unit, unlocking growth opportunities for “our over the counter” and prescription-driven portfolio of pharmaceutical products. Beyond delivering business results, the successful candidate will build capabilities, establish best practices, and progressively develop and lead a high-performing Trade Marketing team.
Tasks & Responsibilities
Develop and execute Trade Marketing strategies aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and brand priorities.
Translate brand plans into customer-specific activation programs and commercial initiatives to drive growth across channels, categories, and shopper segments.
Partner closely with Sales and Key Account teams, supporting customer growth plans, business planning processes, and commercial negotiations through market insights and promotional recommendations.
Leverage market, customer, category, and shopper insights to identify business opportunities, monitor competitive trends, and deliver actionable recommendations.
Lead the planning and execution of customer activation programs across retail and omnichannel environments, ensuring alignment with brand campaigns, media investments, and commercial objectives.
Manage promotional calendars, activation toolkits, and execution standards to deliver consistent and engaging customer experience.
Define, monitor, and analyze Trade Marketing KPIs, evaluate promotional effectiveness and ROI, and provide performance insights and optimization recommendations to stakeholders.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Supply Chain, Finance, Digital Marketing, and external partners to ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives.
Lead projects that enhance commercial effectiveness, customer engagement, and organizational growth.
Establish and develop the Trade Marketing function, build future capabilities, support team growth, and foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Requirements
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
Minimum 8 years of experience in Trade Marketing, Customer Marketing, Category Management, Commercial Marketing, or a similar commercial function.
Proven track record within FMCG, Consumer Health, Animal Health, Retail, E-commerce, or other customer-centric industries.
Strong commercial acumen and deep understanding of customer economics, category dynamics, and business drivers.
Strong analytical and financial capabilities, including data-driven decision making, promotional effectiveness measurement, and ROI evaluation.
Experience managing complex cross-functional stakeholder environments and influencing senior stakeholders across functions.
Strong project management and change management skills, with the ability to lead strategic initiatives and drive organizational improvement.
Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including team development, talent coaching, and capability building.
Experience in retail, pharmacies, and omnichannel environments is considered a strong advantage.
Agile, innovative, and solutions-oriented mindset with a strong focus on continuous improvement.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent Italian and English, both written and spoken.
What we offer
For this position we offer a permanent contract.
The gross annual base salary foreseen for this position ranges from €55.000 to €73.000, depending on candidate's skills and experience.
Free access to the company canteen and ticket restaurants when working remotely.
A range of benefits for physical, financial, social and mental wellbeing.
A support to develop professional and personal paths including our full range of development programs.
We warmly welcome applications from candidates belonging to protected categories, in accordance with Law 68/99.
We foster a workplace built on respect, trust, and empathy—free from discrimination. We are powered by our people, and we believe that our differences are our strengths. Everyone is valued, respected and empowered to be themselves.

Accounting & Controlling Services Sr Specialist
Date:
Oct 6, 2026
Location:
Sesto San Giovanni, Milan, IT, 20099
Additional Location:
Function:
GBS
Grade:
G4
Workplace Type:
Hybrid
Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.
Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns 25 plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in 26 countries, and employs approximately 4,700 people.
Shares of the parent company Davide Campari - Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001. Campari Group is today the sixth-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.
Role Purpose and Mission
The Service Delivery AFR – Managerial is a key role within the Service Delivery Accounting & Financial Reporting team.
The mission of the role is to oversee and manage end-to-end managerial accounting, consolidation, and planning processes across the Campari Group, ensuring accurate, timely, and high-quality financial data that support strategic business decisions.
The role covers both actual and planning activities for managerial reporting, including budget, revised budget, and forecast scenarios. The resource ensures data quality, process efficiency, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement in managerial consolidation and reporting workflows.
Key Responsibilities and Activities
1. Managerial Consolidation Process Management (Actual & Planning)
Oversee the end-to-end managerial consolidation process of financial data across various business units and geographical locations, ensuring data quality meets the expectations of relevant internal stakeholders (Group FP&A, Regional FP&A, Local Finance Directors and House of Brands).
Ensure that the consolidation process aligns with corporate timelines, finance models, and Group Finance requirements.
Collaborate with finance teams across the organization (Local Finance, Regional Finance, Group FP&A and House of Brands) to gather, validate, and consolidate managerial financial data accurately.
Support the implementation and optimization of consolidation SAP systems (BPC, S/4HANA, BW, SAC) to enhance efficiency and accuracy in the consolidation process.
Manage both Actual and Planning scenarios, including Budget (BDG), Revised Budget (RB), and multiple Forecast cycles (FCST).
Coordinate activities with the BPO delivery center to ensure quality, timeliness, and accuracy of consolidation deliverables.
Provide Functional support to SAP implementation related to mergers, acquisition and new LE set-up, ensuring integration on FP&A reporting.
Provide support to local team on submission data process.
2. Data Quality, Validation & Controls
Implement robust data validation and review processes to ensure accuracy and completeness of consolidated managerial data.
Develop and maintain a comprehensive control framework for managerial consolidation, including reconciliation checks, variance analyses, and data integrity controls.
Ensure alignment between managerial data, and between different reporting systems (S/4HANA, BW, BPC, SAC).
Lead initiatives to improve data quality across managerial reporting processes, working closely with Local Finance, Group FP&A and House of Brands.
Act as subject‑matter expert on supply‑chain and product costing topics, including CO‑PA allocations and logistic cost analysis.
Leverage Control Tower framework to ensure recurring reconciliation is executed and assess any open point.
Drive performance monitoring through KPI definition and tracking, ensuring adherence to service levels and quality standards.
3. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as the primary point of contact for managerial consolidation of matters with Group FP&A, Regional FP&A teams, Local Finance Directors, House of Brands, and other business stakeholders.
Coordinate and communicate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on managerial reporting requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
Provide analytical support and business insights to stakeholders based on consolidated managerial data.
Participate in closing and planning meetings with Group Finance stakeholders to discuss results, address issues, and align process improvements.
4. Process Improvement & Innovation
Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives within managerial consolidation and planning processes, leveraging automation, system enhancements, and best practices.
Support the implementation of new systems, tools, and methodologies (e.g., SAP BPC enhancements, integrated planning tools, automation initiatives)
Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and process documentation for managerial consolidation and planning activities.
5. People Management & Team Development
Manage and develop a team of specialists responsible for executing managerial consolidation and planning activities.
Coordinate activities with the BPO partner (currently Accenture delivery centers in India), ensuring clear role definition, quality standards, and service level agreements are met.
Required Qualifications and Experience
Education
Professional Experience
7-10 years of experience in controlling and financial planning & analysis (FP&A)
Experience with managerial consolidation processes, including both actual and planning cycles (Budget, Revised Budget, Forecast)
Experience working in a Global Business Services is highly desirable including coordinating with BPO
Technical Skills & Systems
Advanced knowledge of SAP systems, particularly:
SAP BPC /SAC
SAP S/4HANA
SAP BW
Strong Excel and data analysis skills, including complex financial modeling and variance analysis
Professional Competencies
Strong understanding of managerial accounting principles, including cost allocation, transfer pricing, intercompany eliminations, and profitability analysis
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail
Strong project management capabilities, able to manage multiple priorities and deliver to tight deadlines
Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to interact with senior finance leaders and cross-functional teams
Fluent in English (written and spoken)
Compensation and Grading
The indicative annual gross salary (base salary) for this position ranges within 50 000 - 55 000€ +10% STI, depending on the candidate’s experience, skills, and overall profile.

Help shape the products people will choose tomorrow - Intro to the Innovation tea m
Why do some new products take off while others don’t? What makes someone notice a new pack on the shelf, connect with an idea, or decide to try a product for the first time? At NIQ BASES , we help some of the world’s most exciting brands answer these questions.
As part of our Innovation Insights team , you’ll explore how consumers think and behave, work with data to uncover what really drives their choices, and turn those insights into recommendations that influence real business decisions.
You’ll get exposure to new product ideas, concepts, messaging, packaging and launch strategies , combining consumer research, analytics and commercial thinking to help clients make smarter innovation decisions.
Bring your curiosity, analytical thinking and collaborative spirit to a team that helps clients make confident innovation decisions.
About this job
As a Senior Research Analyst , you won’t just work with data. You’ll turn it into a story.
You’ll take ownership of research projects, collaborate with colleagues across analytics, forecasting, consulting and project delivery, and gradually build your confidence in working directly with clients.
Responsibilities
Turning data into insight: Analyse consumer research and market data to understand what’s happening, why it matters and what our clients should do next.
Bringing insights to life: Create clear, engaging reports, presentations and visual stories that make complex findings easy to understand.
Working on real innovation challenges: Explore new product concepts, packaging, messaging and launch potential for our clients.
Owning your projects: Manage your priorities and deadlines across several studies, working closely with different teams to deliver high-quality research.
Getting closer to clients: Join client conversations, respond to project questions and build confidence presenting findings and recommendations.
Connecting the dots: Combine consumer feedback, market context and forecasting insights to create a compelling story around the potential of an innovation.
Being curious: Look beyond the obvious results, ask the next question and identify additional insights that could make a difference to the client.
Helping others grow: Share your knowledge with junior analysts and support them in developing their analytical and research skills.
Exploring beyond your day-to-day: Get involved in special analyses, client training, thought leadership and other initiatives across the Innovation team.
A little bit about you
We’re looking for someone who is analytical and detail-oriented, but also curious, collaborative and excited about turning numbers into meaningful stories .
Qualifications
​​​ Around 2–3 years of experience in market research, consumer insights, analytics or a related area.
Experience analysing data and creating reports or presentations that explain not only what happened, but why it matters .
A university degree in Marketing, Economics, Business, Psychology, Data/Analytics or another relevant field .
Strong analytical and numerical skills and an understanding of research methods and statistics.
Confidence working with Excel and PowerPoint , and an interest in learning new digital and analytical tools.
Strong communication and data storytelling skills.
Good organisation and the ability to balance multiple priorities and deadlines.
A collaborative mindset and an interest in learning from others while sharing your own knowledge.
Fluency in English , both written and spoken, as you’ll work in an international environment.
Knowledge of German, French or Spanish would be an additional asset , particularly when working with clients across European markets.
Knowledge of forecasting principles is a plus, but you don’t need to know everything on day one. We’re looking for someone who is curious, motivated to learn and ready to grow.

ABOUT AIRWALLEX
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.
We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.
ABOUT THE TEAM
The Regulatory & Compliance Division (RCD) at Airwallex is a collaborative group of legal, compliance and risk management experts. We're passionate about safeguarding Airwallex's operations, fostering a culture of compliance and ethical conduct, and ensuring we navigate the global financial landscape with integrity. We provide expert guidance and support to all areas of the business, proactively identifying, mitigating, and managing legal, compliance and financial risks.
The EMEA Regulatory Compliance Team forms part of the second line of defence (2LOD) at Airwallex whilst operating within the larger RCD function. We are a proactive and trusted business partner committed to enabling Airwallex’s growth and strategic goals by providing an advisory and oversight role. Our team culture is collaborative, impact-driven with a focus on continuous improvement. You’ll be part of a team that values transparency, empowerment, and high performance.
This role is a newly created role with a specific focus on our UK business. This role will be a key member of the EMEA Regulatory Compliance Team, based in our London office with a direct line to the Senior Manager, Regulatory Compliance, UK.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
As Senior Associate / Manager, Regulatory Compliance, UK, you will deliver on the regulatory engagement strategy for Airwallex in the UK. You will maintain our licensing responsibilities and coordinate with all internal and external parties as necessary to ensure compliance through the communication of regulatory requirements, cross-functional collaboration to productize solutions and offerings, implementation and execution of processes, accurate execution and filing of regulatory reports, renewal of registrations and licenses, end-to-end management of regulatory examinations, and interfacing with UK regulators (including the FCA) on ad-hoc inquiries. You will analyse new and existing products and provide guidance to ensure that our 2LOD controls are fit for purpose and comply with regulatory obligations, guide the first line business to enable the maturity of both customer-facing and internal back-office processes and product features.
Responsibilities:
Support the Airwallex Group’s expansion by managing the regulatory compliance components of licence authorisation processes
Act as a key stakeholder in relation to licence applications, business plan updates and information requests between Airwallex and our regulators
Ensure that our regulatory compliance and regulatory reporting obligations are maintained for all Airwallex Group entities in the UK
Support and / or manage on-site exams, inspections and audits (in collaboration with our RCD colleagues)
Advise the business with respect to regulatory change initiatives with a particular focus on how to effectively manage compliance risk attached to new and evolving UK laws and FCA rules
Develop policies, processes and provide advice in relation to regulatory risk obligations that exist within the 1st line business
Manage regulatory compliance risk within the Airwallex Risk Management Framework and associated escalation process (inc. governance forums and board reporting)
Advise the business in relation to conduct risk, Consumer Duty, complaints governance (including Financial Ombudsman Service escalations), and ethics matters relating to our financial services licences
Deliver the Compliance Monitoring Program through assisting with targeted and thematic reviews on a wide range of topics to ensure appropriate organisational maturity
Deliver the Airwallex Group’s Compliance Training for employees and conduct ad-hoc training to specific business areas as required
Conduct ‘Proactive Special Ops’ projects to unlock business or operational issues to enable Airwallex to achieve its strategic goals more rapidly
Who you are
We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree with regulatory compliance experience in a financial institution, FinTech, legal / consulting firm, or combination of the above (minimum 4 years for Senior Associate; minimum 6 years for Manager)
Familiarity with financial regulatory laws, rules, regulations and industry best practices in the UK (specifically FCA-regulated environments)
Data proficiency - ability to work with data and leverage it for strategic decision-making
Ability to operate strategically and think creatively to solve complex regulatory compliance challenges
Superior communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex topics to a wide range of stakeholders including regulators, executive leadership, and front-line staff
Experience with developing and/or maintaining a compliance program within a financial institution, preferably in respect of payments and e-money activity
Exposure to licensing processes, regulatory reporting, regulatory expansion, and RegTech or technology-driven compliance solutions
Understanding of financial products and related conduct risk, ethics, and controls
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience dealing with the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and handling escalations to the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS).
APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS
To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.
Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Connect the Ecosystem: Liaise with external global stakeholders, including major card issuers and networks, to optimize the payment pipeline.

Data Lover: You possess stellar analytical skills and love diving into BI tools (Looker, Power BI, Tableau, Databricks, etc.) to tell a story with data.
Natural Communicator: You are equally comfortable writing deep-dive technical reports and presenting high-level strategy to C-suite client executives.
Thriver of Ambiguity: You are a self-starter who gets excited by a fast-moving, high-growth environment and can drive results without a rigid instruction manual.
Intellectual Curiosity: You have a genuine passion for solving complex puzzles and understanding a customer’s problems inside out.

You’ll be part of a highly collaborative group that partners closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Financial Crime Compliance, Regulatory Compliance, and Legal teams to help Airwallex grow responsibly and with confidence. This is a team where you’ll tackle complex, high-impact challenges, shape how risk is managed at a global fintech, and help build the foundations for long-term scale.
What you'll do
As Head of Risk, you will lead and scale Airwallex’s global second line risk management function across our worldwide operations. This is a senior leadership role for someone who can turn risk management into a business enabler by building robust frameworks, clear governance, effective monitoring, and a strong risk culture across a fast-growing fintech.
You will work closely with the Chief Regulatory and Compliance Officer and senior executives across the company to shape Airwallex’s risk strategy, strengthen enterprise oversight, and ensure our products, markets, and entities operate within approved risk appetite and tolerance levels.
This role is based in UK/Netherlands.
Responsibilities:
Develop and lead Airwallex’s global risk management function and framework, spanning risk monitoring, detection, policy development, governance, escalation, and assurance activities across the Group’s worldwide operations.
Create and execute risk strategies, guidelines, performance metrics, and monitoring mechanisms that identify and mitigate vulnerabilities across Airwallex’s existing and future products, while keeping risk management aligned to business priorities and approved risk appetite.
Partner closely with Risk Product, Risk Operations, Engineering, Product, Data Science, Commercial, Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders to manage risk at the product, portfolio, market, merchant, and entity levels.
Communicate Airwallex’s risk appetite clearly and effectively across the company, helping teams make sound decisions and strengthening consistent adoption of risk standards and accountability.
Collaborate with business, operations, technology, and product leaders to deliver measurable business outcomes while minimising exposure to financial crime, fraud, counterparty, liability, and broader enterprise risks.
Monitor, enhance, and embed the Risk Management Framework so that all global entities operate within acceptable risk tolerance levels and in line with Airwallex’s governance expectations.
Work closely with the Chief Regulatory and Compliance Officer, the CEO, and other senior executives on risk, control, governance, and strategic decision-making topics, including escalation of material issues where appropriate.
Advise management on external risk, governance, and regulatory requirements across the markets in which Airwallex operates, and help ensure the company’s risk posture evolves with its global footprint.
Champion a strong and practical risk culture across Airwallex by reinforcing that risk excellence is a competitive advantage and a shared responsibility across the company.
Recruit, develop, and lead a high performing global team of risk professionals, and help build a scalable second line organisation that can support Airwallex’s next phase of growth.
Who you are
We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, Law, or a related field.
15+ years of relevant experience in Risk Management, Compliance, Control, or Audit within fintech, payments, remittance, banking, or broader financial services.
Strong experience building or leading risk management frameworks, governance models, and oversight programmes in a complex, multi jurisdiction environment.
Demonstrated ability to define and operationalise risk appetite, policies, metrics, and escalation processes that support business growth while maintaining effective control standards.
Experience working closely with senior management and cross functional teams, with excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to influence at executive level.
Experience leading international teams and operating effectively in a fast-paced environment with high standards, evolving priorities, and significant cross functional collaboration.
Preferred qualifications:
Experience in fintech and financial services, especially in payments, consumer finance, remittance, or other global money movement businesses.
A combination of advisory and hands on risk management experience within a financial institution or similarly regulated environment.
Experience partnering with regulators, auditors, boards, or executive risk committees on enterprise risk, governance, and control matters.
Comfort working across a broad risk landscape, including enterprise risk, fraud, counterparty risk, operational risk, and regulatory risk.
An independent, high ownership mindset, with the judgment and pragmatism to balance control effectiveness, innovation, and growth in a scaling global business.

Experience with Salesforce highly regarded.

About the team

You’ll join a collaborative, ambitious and supportive team that thrives on ownership, customer impact and continuous improvement.
What you'll do
As a Technical Account Manager, you’ll be the trusted technical advisor for a portfolio of enterprise and high‑growth customers across Europe. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, engineering and commercial teams: guiding complex API integrations, troubleshooting issues, and using data to drive adoption, expansion and long‑term retention. You’ll combine deep technical understanding of APIs and payment flows with strong stakeholder management skills – from hands‑on engineers through to senior commercial leaders.
This role is based in London, with a 3 days in office policy.
Responsibilities:
Act as the technical owner for a portfolio of customers integrating and scaling on Airwallex’s platforms (APIs, SDKs and system integrations), with a solid understanding of complex technical architectures.
Build deep, hands‑on expertise in Airwallex’s payment, treasury, issuing and embedded finance products, advising customers on best‑practice integration patterns and optimisation opportunities.
Diagnose and resolve complex technical and operational challenges across the stack, coordinating with Commercial, Engineering, Product and Compliance teams to drive timely, high‑quality outcomes.
Serve as a strategic technical partner for enterprise clients: understand their roadmap and priorities, align Airwallex solutions to their goals, and proactively manage the post‑sale relationship to drive adoption, growth and retention.
Plan and lead regular business and technical reviews (e.g. QBRs) with the commercial owner, surfacing insights on performance, risks and opportunities – and turning them into clear action plans.
Own technical escalations for your accounts, providing calm, structured leadership through incidents and ensuring clear, executive‑ready communication throughout.
Partner closely with Account Executives and Account Managers to identify and shape expansion opportunities (upsell and cross‑sell), contributing technical insight into account plans and commercial proposals.
Use product usage data, commercial metrics and client health indicators to monitor account health, prioritise initiatives, and recommend strategies that improve outcomes for both customers and Airwallex.
Stay current on the European payments and fintech landscape (including regulations such as PSD2 and local market nuances) and translate that knowledge into practical guidance for customers.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly and confidently to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders, adapting your style across cultures and audiences.
Who you are
We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.
Minimum qualifications:
5+ years in a technical customer‑facing role (e.g. Technical Account Manager, Solutions Consultant, Technical CSM, Implementation Manager) within payments, fintech, SaaS or financial services.
Strong technical foundation with solid understanding of APIs, SDKs, webhooks and system integrations, and the ability to quickly grasp complex technical architectures.
Proven, hands‑on experience designing, implementing and supporting integrations for payment or similar financial product stacks.
Demonstrated track record of diagnosing and solving complex technical and operational issues, working through cross‑functional teams to drive resolution.
Experience acting as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers, including managing post‑sale relationships, leading structured reviews (e.g. QBRs) and handling high‑stakes escalations.
Evidence of a commercial mindset – comfortable partnering with sales and account management teams to identify and shape upsell and cross‑sell opportunities.
Fluency in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both engineers and senior non‑technical stakeholders.
Self‑starter who thrives in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment, able to manage multiple complex accounts and willing to travel within Europe as required.
Preferred qualifications:
Deep domain knowledge of the European payments, fintech or financial services landscape, including familiarity with regulations such as PSD2, SEPA and major local payment methods.
Proficiency in at least one additional major European language (e.g. German, French, Spanish or Dutch) to support client engagement across the region.
Experience using data and analytics (e.g. dashboards, logs, basic querying) to monitor product usage, understand client behaviour and inform recommendations or prioritisation.
Background working closely with or within Product, Engineering, Compliance and Operations teams, with a track record of influencing roadmaps based on customer needs and market insights.
Prior experience in a scale‑up or similar high‑growth environment, with comfort navigating ambiguity and contributing to building new processes and best practices.About the team

In this role, you’ll blend analytical rigor with hands-on execution — partnering closely with Growth Strategy, Product Marketing, Creative, and Analytics to translate business objectives into efficient, scalable campaigns. You’ll be instrumental in building the frameworks, insights, and best practices that power our global demand generation engine.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Planning
Develop and execute multi-channel paid media strategies (SEM, paid social, programmatic/display, YouTube, retargeting) aligned with funnel goals and business priorities.
Own budget planning, forecasting, and pacing to meet CAC, ROAS, and pipeline targets.
Collaborate with regional and product marketing teams to localize campaigns and ensure relevance across markets.
Recommend new growth opportunities, audiences, and channels based on data-driven insights.
Execution & Optimization
Build and manage paid campaigns end-to-end: keyword/audience selection, ad copy, creative testing, and bid strategy.
Continuously optimize for performance , leveraging testing frameworks (A/B, multivariate, holdout experiments) to improve CTR, CVR, and CPL.
Monitor and report on campaign performance daily and weekly, identifying trends and actionable insights.
Ensure proper tracking and attribution (UTMs, pixels, offline conversions, Salesforce/Marketo sync).
Manage and QA all campaign builds following standardized naming conventions and governance frameworks .
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Creative and Content to develop ad variations tailored to audience segments and funnel stages.
Collaborate with Analytics and RevOps to ensure visibility into lead quality, pipeline contribution, and ROI.
Work with Product Marketing to align messaging, audience strategy, and campaign sequencing.
Testing & Insights
Maintain a structured testing roadmap across channels for creative, audience, and bidding experiments.
Surface insights on platform algorithm changes, auction dynamics, and audience performance trends.
Share performance learnings across regions to scale best practices globally.
Qualifications
5–8 years of experience managing paid media programs in B2B SaaS, fintech, or e-commerce environments.
Deep hands-on expertise in the breadth of DemandGen and Acquisition and across ad unit types in Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and Meta Ads (other platforms like YouTube, Reddit, Quora, and programmatic are a plus).
Proven success optimizing campaigns for pipeline, ROI, and LTV:CAC efficiency.
Strong analytical skills; comfortable using Excel/Sheets, Looker, Tableau, or GA4 to analyze campaign data.
Experience with marketing automation and CRM systems (Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce).
Exceptional project management and attention to detail — able to run multiple campaigns simultaneously.
Excellent communicator who can translate performance data into actionable business insights.

WHO YOU ARE
We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard.
Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale.
Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements.
Ensure accurate payment cost configuration: Translate complex scheme rules into fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic. Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows.
Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution.
Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements.
Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers. Partner with Product, Finance and Commercial teams to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.
Shape pricing and commercial decisions: Translate underlying payment economics into recommendations for customer pricing, product design, new market launches and commercial strategy, ensuring growth is supported by sustainable unit economics.
Build scalable infrastructure and automation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to strengthen cost engines, fee allocation logic, dashboards and automated controls. Apply AI and advanced analytics to accelerate rule interpretation, detect anomalies and surface optimization opportunities.
Own complex scheme economics issues: Serve as the escalation point for scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions, working directly with Visa, Mastercard and other payment partners where required.
WHAT YOU’LL BRING
7+ years of relevant experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or related roles, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.
Deep knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules.
Strong ability to operationalize complex payment rules, translating fee schedules and network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls.
Experience with payment cost systems and controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations.
Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modeling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs.
Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to connect detailed payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimization.
Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale.
Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners.

You’ll lead our Payments Product team, focused on building and optimizing the core clearing and settlement platform that powers how money moves across card networks, banks, ledgers, and most importantly: our merchants' wallets. Owning the end-to-end merchant experience: From instant, low-friction onboarding through to the ongoing lifecycle, reducing complexity at every step.
Optimizing global payment flows: Enhancing platform capabilities (e.g., intelligent batching, fee netting, routing) to improve settlement speed, accuracy, and cash velocity.
Strengthening infrastructure: Driving reliability, compliance, and liquidity management to deliver resilient capabilities for reconciliation and regulatory reporting.
Deploying AI-native capabilities: Embedding autonomous agents into how we interact with merchants, collect feedback, and automate traditional industry workflows—powering smarter support, proactive insights, and real-time visibility.
You’ll work closely with product, engineering, design, and commercial teams to bring these cutting-edge capabilities to life, and help shape the infrastructure behind one of the most dynamic, AI-forward fintech platforms in the world.

Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate product strategy across technical and non-technical teams.
Analytical rigour: a sharp eye for detail, structured problem-solving skills, and a data-driven mindset.
Bias for action: grit, persistence, and ownership to turn complex ideas into real-world products quickly.
Collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in cross-functional, cross-cultural teams.

ABOUT AIRWALLEX
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.
We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.
About the Team
The Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team at Airwallex is a strategically vital function operating under a clear Three Lines of Defense model. As the independent second line, FCC owns the global AML/CTF program, sanctions framework, risk assessment methodology, and governance infrastructure across all global entities. As Airwallex scales into new markets and deepens its engagement with global regulatory bodies, we are building a world-class compliance organization capable of managing complex financial crime risks at scale. This is an environment where you will tackle high-impact challenges, shape global fintech risk strategies, and help establish foundations for long-term growth.
What you'll do
As Senior Director, AML & Sanctions, Governance & Policy, you will shape and scale Airwallex’s global financial crime policy and risk based program, establish risk appetite and design global risk assessment processes, and define governance frameworks, ensuring compliance is a strategic enabler of growth. You will establish the baseline core compliance standards while guiding regional adaptations, oversee definition of controls across the FCC control framework, strengthen executive risk reporting, oversee risk-informed product engineering, and defend the integrity of the platform before global regulators and institutional partners. You will work closely with the Chief Regulatory and Compliance Officer, Global Head of FCC and senior leaders across the business to turn complex compliance trends into clear action, and shape strategic priorities and initiatives while scaling a high-performing, multi-disciplinary global team.
This role is based in London.
Responsibilities:
Lead the evolution and maintenance of Airwallex's Global Core FCC Policy Framework, ensuring the compliance baseline meets the expectations of global regulators while supporting business growth and regional scalability.
Lead the definition and oversight of the FCC governance model and risk management framework, including establishment of risk appetite incorporating business strategy, establishing the risk management framework, including risk acceptance & governance structure, and overseeing design and execution of the enterprise risk assessment
Define the methodology, thresholds, and data-scoring models used to identify and mitigate financial crime risks globally, partnering with Product, Data Science, and Engineering executives to embed automated compliance controls into the proprietary platform.
Translate complex compliance data, issues, and audit findings into clear, decision-useful reporting for executive leadership and the Board’s Audit and Risk Committee, establishing clear protocols for material risk escalations.
Oversee the strategy for regulatory examination defense and disclosure governance, ensuring the team delivers uniform, legally defensible evidence portfolios to global regulators and external clearing partners.
Drive a unified, risk-aware compliance culture across the organization by establishing the strategic vision for global financial crime training and capability building from engineering to sales teams.
Support the Global Head of FCC and Chief Regulatory and Compliance Officer in setting and overseeing strategic FCC program priorities and continuous improvement initiatives
Build and lead a high-performing global second line team of compliance attorneys, quantitative risk modelers, policy writers, and governance managers, supporting Airwallex’s growth with technology-enabled compliance oversight.
Who you are
We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Law, Criminology, Public Policy, Finance, Business Administration, International Relations, or a related analytical field.
CAMS certification or an equivalent globally recognized compliance credential (e.g., ICA International Diploma in AML).
12 to 15+ years of experience in AML, Sanctions, and Financial Crime Compliance within financial services, fintech, payments, or banking.
At least 5+ years leading a global or multi-jurisdictional compliance policy, governance, or risk methodology function at a senior level.
Proven experience designing enterprise-wide risk assessment frameworks and maintaining highly centralized global policies with localized regional addenda.
Demonstrated experience preparing risk papers and leading the defense during high-stakes regulatory examinations and internal or external audits.
A high-ownership, pragmatic approach, with excellent written communication and stakeholder management skills to influence cross-functional executives and board audiences.
Preferred qualifications:
Advanced degree such as a Juris Doctor (JD), Master of Laws (LLM), or a Master’s degree in Regulatory Compliance or Financial Crime.
Advanced professional designations such as CAMS-Audit, CGSS (Certified Global Sanctions Specialist), or CAMS-RM (Risk Management).
Deep fintech and payments experience, including a strong understanding of cross-border payment mechanisms, virtual accounts, multi-currency wallets, or multi-entity regulated groups.
Experience partnering directly with Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams to hardcode policy thresholds into automated transaction monitoring, screening, and onboarding workflows.
Strong data literacy and a clear bias toward digital modernization, including the use of automated GRC systems, dashboards, and technology-enabled tools to improve compliance office efficiency.
APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS
To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.
Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
